about_the_game:
The year is 1984. The hospital was never meant to heal—it was built to feed.

County Hospital Cautery is a co-op and single-player sci-fi horror experience for up to four players, set in a world where science has gone too far. Equipped with isolation suits, oxygen masks, and industrial flamethrowers, your team must descend into the depths of a decaying hospital and a hidden laboratory where unspeakable experiments fused human tissue with this organism DNA. What began as research soon became a feeding ground for an unknown creature. Your ultimate objective: infiltrate the underground laboratory, ignite every remaining specimen, and destroy the colossal organism under the main rocket launcher test site by searching for specific objects in the map. But there’s one last threat. The infection spreads silently, and one of your teammates might already be infected. When the transformation begins, they will turn into a monstrous arachnid and hunt the others until destroyed. Time is running!

GAMEPLAY FEATURES 

  • Flamethrower Fuel System – The flamethrower uses a limited gas supply that decreases with every use. Running out of gas leaves the player defenseless without weapons.

  • Stamina & Energy Management – Sprinting, kicking and flashlight consume stamina, which regenerates slowly over time, low energy means walking tired and without strength and no use of flashlight.

  • Recharge Station Mechanics – The large mobile energy trailer functions as a central hub where players can fully restore gas, stamina, and health in a short time.

  • Transformation Mechanic (Infection System Only Multiplayer) – One player can become infected during gameplay. The infected player transforms into a mutated arachnid, gaining unique movement abilities such as faster speed, silent climbing, and unlimited stamina. The transformed player loses access to human equipment but gains enhanced melee attacks and stealth capabilities.

  • Explore and loot with achievements – Explore the map to find useful items such as operating system diskettes, power batteries, medkits, grenades, ammunition, weapons and more on secundary missions.

  • Cooperative Gameplay Design – The game supports 1–4 players. Resource management, timing, and teamwork are critical. Players must plan recharge cycles, share supplies, and cover each other while completing objectives inside the contaminated facility.

  • Ultimate graphics made with Unreal Engine 5 and original music score

Experiments in a secret laboratory hidden behind an abandoned hospital have gone too far, you and your team must use all the equipment to eliminate the threat before a worse one awakens. Get your flametrhower!
